<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 194.0862, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 193.079 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed isotopic pattern (≈ 13 % M+1, consistent with ~12 C atoms) is C₁₁H₁₃O₃. This fits the required format.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H13O3</final_answer>
